top_choice_rationale: Can Xue (P001) is my first choice on literary grounds. Her voice is distinctive. Her dream logic works as a rigorously kept formal principle, not decorative surrealism, and replaces realist psychology, spatial coherence and causal plot. The method has been pursued over decades with imaginative and intellectual seriousness, and a single-writer citation resting on the fiction is clean. I hold this as a close, provisional judgment based on public knowledge and translated selections. I have not verified the corpus, I cannot assess the Chinese prose directly, and whether the longer novels sustain the invention of the best short fiction is unresolved. Cărtărescu (P002) is a serious second choice, with a citation centred on the novels. His scale and range are real, but the cost of repetition in very long cycles is not settled. Either proposal ranks above no award (P000), because the committee has not shown that neither candidate meets the standard of Nobel's will.
